title: Not So Dire Straits
summary:
Not So Dire Straits
As the days get shorter, one market that becomes of particular interest is the Black Sea. Overall traffic, restricted transit to daylight hours and weather can add to congestion and complicate trading and transit of the Turkish Straits. For example, on Monday of this week, the Bosphorus was closed due to heavy current.

children.summary: Southbound The volume of crude exported from the Black Sea from the Former Soviet Union (FSU) states is approximately 2.3 million barrels per day, according to the IEA. Increases in exports out of the region will only serve to create more congestion for all vessels looking to travel the route.
